text.text_excerpt: Visited Whiskey & Sticks multiple times now, so much so I was a regular or Fridays/Saturdays for a little bit there! I think one of the main things that drew me back so many times was the lady bartender (Sadly her name is escaping me at the moment). She was knowledgeable, friendly, helpful and got me to try a new whiskey each time I was there. It was always a pleasure of experiencing different great whiskeys available at the moment. My favorites at the moment at this location in Balvenie and Ohan at the moment at least. The atmosphere is sexy and laid back, you can just chill and listen to music here for extended periods of times. It's a WHOLE vibe and I love that. This is a great locatio...

Great selection of whiskeys! I was here on a chill Wednesday night, celebrating a friend's birthday. There were HH specials (a punch called Tiger Woods) and our bartender/owner was amazing. I got to try 2 new to me whiskies so that's exciting and the feeling is more like you're in someone's awesome home bar. Definitely seemed like most folks were getting straight pours rather than fancy cocktails. The space is lovely with a variety of seating and a cool vibe. There is space out back to enjoy the Sticks portion of the menu and though it was rainy several of my friends enjoyed the space & the cigars while under an umbrella. The owner also moved some chairs to under the front awning. Be prep...

Excellent cocktails, nice courtyard, beautiful space. I cannot wait to come back to Whiskey & Sticks. As we walked in, the staff greeted us so warmly that I thought they knew me from somewhere. It was cool to get a Cheers vibe upon my first visit! We were there for a comedy event in the courtyard. There was ample seating and good acoustics. Best of all, I never had to leave my chair to get another drink. The staff was on top of it! They were taking orders, bussing and returning with full trays so quickly. It was truly impressive.
